_comment: Which Lakehorse tracks the game plays, and which mood each one covers.
This file is the game's ONLY public audio surface. S'music's real library sits
behind get_library(band, password), and the game is a public page — shipping
that password in the source would hand anyone who views it the keys to the
unreleased mixes. So instead: you list here, by hand, the tracks you're happy
for the whole internet to hear. Nothing else is reachable from the game.
'src' is the object path inside the public 'tracks' bucket in Supabase — the
same path S'music stores, with or without the leading 'tracks/'. Upload a mix
through S'music as normal, then paste its path here.
Any layer with no track falls back to the calm one, so a single track works
fine and more tracks just make it richer.
